points.description: Names both phases correctly: Slow Start and Congestion Avoidance (both required, correct terms).
Slow start: cwnd increases by 1 per acknowledged segment, giving exponential growth (doubling each RTT), while cwnd < ss_thresh; ss_thresh is unchanged during growth.
points.partial_credit: 0.125 if only exponential growth/doubling per RTT is stated without the per-ACK +1 rule (or vice versa)

points.description: Congestion avoidance (cwnd >= ss_thresh): cwnd grows slowly/linearly, e.g. +1 per RTT once all sent segments are acknowledged; ss_thresh unchanged during growth.
points.partial_credit: 0.125 if only 'slower/linear growth' stated without the specific increment

points.description: On packet loss/congestion (in either phase): ss_thresh is set to cwnd/2 (stated precisely).

On packet loss/congestion (in either phase): cwnd is reset to 1, and the phase transition is correct (slow start ends at cwnd >= ss_thresh and enters congestion avoidance; after loss, slow start is re-entered).

rubric.notes: Full marks need both phase names and precise cwnd/ss_thresh behaviour: +1 per ACK/exponential in slow start, linear (+1 per RTT) in congestion avoidance, and on loss ss_thresh = cwnd/2 and cwnd = 1. Vague statements such as 'grows faster' or 'cwnd is reduced' earn nothing; give part marks only where clearly more than half is precise. A wrong detail (e.g. cwnd halved instead of reset to 1, or wrong phase growth) cancels that point.
